# Hope for Depression Research Foundation

> A nonprofit research foundation dedicated to funding innovative depression research, advancing treatment development, and raising awareness about mental health through scientific collaboration and community engagement.

The Hope for Depression Research Foundation (HDRF) focuses on closing the treatment gap in depression through strategic research funding, clinical trial initiatives, and partnerships with leading neuroscience institutions. The organization is led by founder Audrey Gruss and supported by a scientific advisory council of psychiatry and neuroscience experts.

## Key Topics

- Depression research
- Treatment innovation
- Clinical trials
- Neuroscience
